unit: one row per effect (not per study)
provenance_rule: Every numeric field must carry a page/locator and a verbatim quote (<=25 words) it came from. A numeric field with no locatable source is null with extraction_confidence 0. Never a guess.
no_conversion_rule: Effect sizes are extracted exactly as reported. No standardization or conversion here; that happens in step 4 in R.

sample_overlap_group.note: assigned from the known-cohort registry; null + flagged when unrecognized

n.note: analytic sample size for this effect

volume_pipeline.note: FreeSurfer version / FSL FIRST / VBM / manual tracing

se_or_ci.note: standard error or confidence interval, as reported

p_value.note: as reported, e.g. "< .001", ".003"; not coerced to a float (never convert here)

direction_coded_positive_means_higher_SE.note: true if the sign is oriented so positive = higher SES with larger volume

page_number.note: page number for PDFs, or section/table locator for XML with no pages

verbatim_quote.note: <=25 words, the text or table cell the effect_value came from
